            ! 3)  Allocate and read vegetation properties for every species
            do is=1,par%nveg  ! for each species
               ! read vegetation file name
               call check_file_exist(veg(is)%name)
               ! Check if it is canopy flow model type
               veg(is)%isCanopy = readkey_int(veg(is)%name,'isCanopy',0,0,1,bcast=.false.,strict=.true.)
               ! check that the canopy flow model is on if applying canopy types
               if (veg(is)%isCanopy==1 .and. par%porcanflow .ne. 1) then
                   call writelog('ewls','','Canopy type vegetation can only be used together with the canopy flow model')
                   call halt_program
               endif
               ! check number of sections
               veg(is)%nsec    = readkey_int(veg(is)%name,'nsec',  1,        1,      100, bcast=.false.,strict=.true.)
               ! if canopy flow model is used then a maximum of nsec = 1
               if (veg(is)%isCanopy==1 .and. veg(is)%nsec>1) then
                   call writelog('ewls','','Canopy type vegetation can only have nsec = 1')
                   call halt_program
               endif
